sentences.en: Don't have anything to do with him. He is completely untrustworthy.
sentences.zh: 别和他有任何瓜葛。他完全不值得信任。

sentences.en: You can believe him. He's not an untrustworthy person.
sentences.zh: 你可以相信他。他不是那种靠不住的人。

sentences.en: He is one of the most untrustworthy people I have ever met.
sentences.zh: 他是我遇到过的最不值得信任的人之一。

senses.zh: 不值得信任的， 靠不住的
